seoTitle: Business Model Canvas Builder With Nine Blocks
metaDescription: Add notes to the nine blocks of the business model canvas and get a printable one-page canvas. Free, runs in your browser.
intro: Lays the nine business model canvas blocks out on one page you can save or print.
why:
The business model canvas describes how a business creates and captures value in nine blocks, from key partners to revenue streams. Putting it on a single page makes the links between blocks visible.

Write a point per line in each block. The result is an HTML page to save or print to PDF. Nothing is uploaded.
howTo: Write notes for each block, one per line.

faq.q: What is the difference from a lean canvas?
faq.a: The lean canvas focuses on problem and solution for startups; this one covers partners and resources.

faq.q: Can I add more than one note?
